title: MBBQ: A Dataset for Cross-Lingual Comparison of Stereotypes in Generative LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2406.07243v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative large language models (LLMs) have been shown to exhibit harmful biases and stereotypes. While safety fine-tuning typically takes place in English, if at all, these models are being used by speakers of many different languages. There is existing evidence that the performance of these models is inconsistent across languages and that they discriminate based on demographic factors of the user. Motivated by this, we investigate whether the social stereotypes exhibited by LLMs differ as a function of the language used to prompt them, while controlling for cultural differences and task accuracy. To this end, we present MBBQ (Multilingual Bias Benchmark for Question-answering), a carefully curated version of the English BBQ dataset extended to Dutch, Spanish, and Turkish, which measures stereotypes commonly held across these languages. translated_title: MBBQ：一个用于生成式大语言模型中刻板印象跨语言比较的数据集
translated_abstract: 生成式大语言模型（LLMs）已被证明会表现出有害的偏见和刻板印象。虽然安全微调通常（如果进行的话）只在英语中进行，但这些模型正被使用多种不同语言的用户所使用。已有证据表明，这些模型在不同语言之间的表现不一致，并且会根据用户的人口统计特征进行歧视。基于此，我们研究了LLMs所表现出的社会刻板印象是否随提示所用语言的不同而变化，同时控制文化差异和任务准确性的影响。为此，我们提出了MBBQ（多语言偏见问答基准），这是英语BBQ数据集的精心策划版本，扩展到了荷兰语、西班牙语和土耳其语，用于衡量这些语言中普遍存在的刻板印象。我们还通过一个平行的控制数据集来补充MBBQ，以衡量模型的任务表现。
tldr: 提出了MBBQ多语言偏见基准数据集，将英语BBQ数据集精心扩展至荷兰语、西班牙语和土耳其语，用于在控制文化差异和任务准确性的前提下，研究LLMs表现出的社会刻板印象是否随提示语言的不同而变化。
en_tdlr: We present MBBQ, a carefully curated multilingual bias benchmark extending the English BBQ dataset to Dutch, Spanish, and Turkish, to investigate whether social stereotypes exhibited by LLMs differ depending on the language used to prompt them, while controlling for cultural differences and task accuracy.
